scope: Provide a safe, versioned template start for creating a new Editor draft page without changing existing drafts or public pages.

implementation.catalog_owner: Design System catalog is isolated at public/editor-v2/core/design-system/template-catalog.js.
implementation.compatibility: Each catalog entry declares template version and Page Model schema version; apply rejects unknown, unsupported, or incompatible entries.
implementation.node_identity: Every created instance uses crypto.randomUUID-backed IDs, reconstructs parent/child relationships from an allowlisted template graph, rejects orphan/duplicate references, and validates the resulting Editor document.
implementation.ui: Accessible new-page dialog with keyboard-selectable templates, preview, title and slug fields, cancel, inline validation, busy and error states, and retry after a site-local slug conflict.
implementation.safety: Only a new page draft is created through the existing site-scoped admin page API; no existing page replacement or publication path is called. The creator template uses generic sample text, no secret, no external URL, no custom code, and no assumed channel handle.
implementation.rollback: Cancel before submit performs no write. A created new draft is reversible through the existing explicitly confirmed page-delete operation; the browser test checks the previous published page remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
